papers.title: Motion-Conditioned Multi-View Fusion for Myocardial Infarction Localization from Echocardiography
papers.authors: Guang Yang, Wentian Xu, Siyu Wang, Betty Raman, Lei Li, Vicente Grau
papers.affiliations: University of Oxford (Department of Engineering Science, Radcliffe Department of Medicine), National University of Singapore (Department of Biomedical Engineering)
papers.intro: 提出MCF-Net，一种运动条件化的多视图融合框架，通过极稀疏标注的运动先验（单张模板帧）与预训练超声基础模型（EchoPrime）的视觉特征进行运动引导软细化和运动条件交叉视图融合，显著提升了节段级MI定位的性能（F1 72.4%，ACC 84.9%）。

papers.title: HoloGeo: Mitigating Landmark Bias in Geo-localization via Evidence-Driven Reasoning
papers.authors: Pengcheng Zhou, Xuanyu Liu, Yanchen Yin, Bobo Li, Shengqiong Wu, Mong-Li Lee, Wynne Hsu
papers.affiliations: National University of Singapore, Shandong University of Science and Technology, University of Oxford
papers.intro: 本文系统研究了地理定位中的地标偏差问题，提出量化指标（BI和BH）和专有基准LandmarkBias-3K，并构建HoloGeo框架，通过多证据推理数据集BF-30K和多维奖励设计，显式鼓励模型均衡关注多种视觉线索，有效缓解地标偏差并提升定位可靠性。

papers.title: ARMOR++: Agentic Orchestration of a Multi-Domain Primitive Set for Transferable Attacks on Deepfake Detectors
papers.authors: Christos Korgialas, Gabriel Lee Jun Rong, Dion Jia Xu Ho, Pai Chet Ng, Xiaoxiao Miao, Konstantinos N. Plataniotis
papers.affiliations: Aristotle University of Thessaloniki, Singapore Institute of Technology, Columbia University, Duke Kunshan University, University of Toronto
papers.intro: ARMOR++是一种基于视觉-语言模型和大语言模型的多智能体框架，通过编排五种域互补的对抗原始操作（密集优化、显著性、空间变换、频域、块结构），在严格无查询黑盒迁移设置下高效地欺骗深度伪造检测器。

papers.title: CRISP: Constrained Refinement via Iterative Squeezing Process for Robust Medical Image Segmentation under Domain Shift
papers.authors: Yizhou Fang, Pujin Cheng, Yixiang Liu, Xiaoying Tang, Longxi Zhou
papers.affiliations: 南方科技大学（电子与电气工程系、生物医学工程系），香港大学，嘉兴研究院
papers.intro: CRISP提出一种模型无关的框架，基于“正区域排名稳定性”假设，通过潜在特征扰动提取高精度和高召回空间提示，并迭代挤压两者之间的不确定性间隙，实现无需目标域数据或测试时参数更新的鲁棒医学图像分割。

papers.title: Divergent Gaze Patterns in Artistic Viewing: Spatial and Temporal Signatures of Attention Across Autistic Individuals, Artists, and Neurotypical Observers
papers.authors: Mohammed Amine Kerkouri, Daphné Senggaran, Renaud Jusiak, Océane Lehmann, Marouane Tliba, Claire Wardak, Emmanuelle Houy-Durand, Shasha Morel-Kohlmeyer, Aladine Chetouani, Nadia Aguillon-Hernandez
papers.affiliations: F-initiatives (Paris, France); Université de Tours (Tours, France); Université d'Orléans (Orléans, France); Université Sorbonne Paris Nord (Villetaneuse, France)
papers.intro: 本研究通过双轴（空间+时间）定量框架对比自闭症成人、艺术家和神经典型观察者的自由观看眼动模式，发现艺术家和神经典型在空间和时间上高度一致，而自闭症个体具有独特的注意特征：空间探索类似艺术家（广散布），但时间上注视更短、更异质，且自闭症注视模式并非选择性更像任何一方。

papers.title: Structural-Semantic Reciprocal Learning for Unsupervised Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification
papers.authors: Moyao Tian, Shijia Liu, Yan Yang, Xin Yuan, Minshi Chen, Wei Wang, Xiao Wang
papers.affiliations: School of Computer Science and Technology, Wuhan University of Science and Technology；Hubei Province Key Laboratory of Intelligent Information Processing and Real-Time Industrial System, Wuhan University of Science and Technology；State Key Laboratory of Robotics and Intelligent Systems, Shenyang Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences；China University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
papers.intro: 本文提出结构-语义互惠学习框架（SSRL），通过细粒度结构解耦（FSD）提供跨模态空间锚点、闭环语义校准（CSC）过滤伪标签噪声，将传统开环渐进式关联转变为自校正的闭环系统，在无监督条件下实现鲁棒的可见光-红外行人重识别。

papers.title: Symbal: Detecting Systematic Misalignments in Model-Generated Captions
papers.authors: Maya Varma, Jean-Benoit Delbrouck, Sophie Ostmeier, Akshay Chaudhari, Curtis Langlotz
papers.affiliations: Stanford University, HOPPR
papers.intro: 本文提出了SYMBAL，一种两阶段结构化方法，利用现成基础模型自动检测MLLM生成描述中的系统性误对齐，并创建了首个专用基准SYMBALBENCH（包含170万图像-文本对、420个数据集），验证了方法的有效性。

papers.title: MAGiSt3R: Multi-Agent Feed-forward 3D Reconstruction from Monocular RGB Videos
papers.authors: Ziren Gong, Xiaohan Li, Fabio Tosi, Ninghui Xu, Stefano Mattoccia, Jianfei Cai, Matteo Poggi
papers.affiliations: 未明确（作者所属机构见第十二节）
papers.intro: 本文提出MAGiSt3R，第一个多智能体前馈式3D重建框架，通过VGGT等3R模型生成局部点图，并利用新提出的MAGMA模块在智能体内和智能体间增量融合子图，配合位姿图优化，在单目RGB视频上实现接近10 FPS的高质量3D重建和相机跟踪。

papers.title: MM-IssueLoc: A Controlled Benchmark for Evaluating Visual Evidence in Multimodal Repository-Level Issue Localization
papers.authors: Shaoxiong Zhan, Shi Hu, Boyu Feng, Hai Lin, Andrew Gong, Zhengda Zhou, Jiaying Zhou, Yunyun Hou, Hao Su, Hai-Tao Zheng
papers.affiliations: Tsinghua University; JD.com
papers.intro: MM-IssueLoc 是一个受控的多模态仓库级问题定位基准与评估协议，通过配对文本/图像模式、逐图像相关性和文件/函数级金标签，把视觉证据变成显式评估变量，揭示现有系统在多模态定位上的能力差距。

papers.title: DAPGNet: Dynamic Adaptive Physics-Guided Graph Diffusion Network for Hyperspectral Image Classification
papers.authors: Pengkun Wang, Weijia Cao, Ning Wang, Xiaofei Yang
papers.affiliations: 中国科学院空天信息创新研究院, 中国科学院大学, 广州大学
papers.intro: DAPGNet通过多尺度光谱物理先验编码、物理先验感知的图构建和物理门控图扩散，将光谱物理先验注入图学习的全流程（拓扑、注意偏置、特征插值），在高光谱图像分类上显著超越CNN、Transformer、Mamba和图网络基线。

papers.title: AlphaWiSE: Adaptive Weight Interpolation for Continual Multimodal Representation Learning
papers.authors: Sarthak Jain, Qiran Hu, Zhen Zhu, Yaoyao Liu
papers.affiliations: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign; Google DeepMind
papers.intro: AlphaWiSE提出一种事后（post-hoc）权重空间插值方法，通过固定两个不同持续学习策略产生的冻结检查点，利用少量样本记忆学习每个参数张量的标量插值系数，融合生成单一模型，在不增加推理时间的前提下持续提升多模态检索性能。

papers.title: VideoChat3: Fully Open Video MLLM for Efficient and Generalist Video Understanding
papers.authors: Xinhao Li, Yuhan Zhu, Xiangyu Zeng, Yuhao Dong, Haoning Wu, Zhiqiu Zhang, Yuandong Yang, Changlian Ma, Qingyu Zhang, Yansong Shi, Xinyu Chen, Haoran Chen, Zizheng Huang, Jun Zhang, Kun Ouyang, Lin Sui, Ziang Yan, Yicheng Xu, Chenting Wang, Yinan He, Hongjie Zhang, Yi Wang, Yu Qiao, Yali Wang, Ziwei Liu, Kai Chen, Limin Wang
papers.affiliations: Nanjing University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Nanyang Technological University, Peking University
papers.intro: VideoChat3是一个完全开源、高效且通用的视频多模态大语言模型，通过引入膨胀3D视觉Transformer（I3D-ViT）和自适应帧分辨率，实现高效时空编码，并配合大规模数据合成流水线，在4B参数量下超越同规模开源模型。

papers.title: Blurring Modal Boundaries: A Unified Survey from Single- to Multi-Modal Person Re-ldentification
papers.authors: Xiao Wang, Bing Wang, Bin Yang, Cuiqun Chen, Xin Xu, Mang Ye
papers.affiliations: 武汉科技大学；武汉大学；安徽大学
papers.intro: 本文系统性地综述了从单模态到多模态的行人重识别研究，提出了基于检索协议和学习目标的统一分类法，并给出了一个基于Transformer的可见光-红外ReID基线框架。

papers.title: VideoRAE: Taming Video Foundation Models for Generative Modeling via Representation Autoencoders
papers.authors: Zhihao Xie, Junfeng Wu, Xinting Hu, Junchao Huang, Li Jiang
papers.affiliations: 香港中文大学（深圳）、华中科技大学、深圳环区域研究所、中国科学技术大学
papers.intro: VideoRAE利用冻结的视频基础模型编码器，通过轻量级1D自注意力投影器将多尺度层次特征压缩为紧凑的潜在空间，支持连续（扩散Transformer）和离散（自回归模型）两种生成范式，无需KL正则化，实现了高保真重建和更快的生成模型收敛。

papers.title: From Pixels to States: Rethinking Interactive World Models as Game Engines
papers.authors: Zhen Li, Zian Meng, Shuwei Shi, Mingliang Zhai, Jiaming Tan, Chuanhao Li, Kaipeng Zhang
papers.affiliations: Alaya Lab
papers.intro: 本文以传统游戏引擎的“动作-状态-观测”循环为组织框架，系统审视交互式游戏世界建模的四个维度，并构建了一个可扩展的数据引擎，为《黑神话：悟空》收集了90多小时带帧对齐动作、真实状态和语义标注的游戏数据。

papers.title: Multi-Expert Routing for Multi-Domain Low-Resource OCR: A Manchu Case Study
papers.authors: Zhan Chen, Jiqiao Ma, Chih-wen Kuo
papers.affiliations: Institute of Advanced Studies, Beijing Normal University, Zhuhai, China; Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences, Beijing Normal University–Hong Kong Baptist University United International College (UIC), Zhuhai, China; Independent Scholar; Department of Applied History, National Chiayi University, Chiayi, Taiwan
papers.intro: 本文提出一个多专家路由系统，利用迭代微调过程中产生的检查点作为域专家，并训练一个轻量级页面级图像分类器来按视觉风格分配页面，在满文多域低资源OCR任务中达到与域标签oracle一致的最优精度（正楷0.30% CER，奏折1.57%，行书4.83%）。

papers.title: M$^\text{4}$World: A Multi-view Multimodal Driving World Model for Interactive Object Manipulation and Minute-long Streaming
papers.authors: Ke Cheng, Hanqiao Ye, Lei Shi, Yahui Liu, Yunhan Shen, Jingtao Dong, Zhenke Wang, Wenxuan Ao, Weixiang Xu, Kaining Huang, Shuhan Shen
papers.affiliations: Meituan, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing Institute of Technology
papers.intro: 提出M4World，一种多视图多模态驾驶世界模型，通过结合细粒度物体控制接口（同时控制空间布局与视觉外观）和多阶段训练框架（实现四步去噪的因果流式生成），支持交互式物体操作和分钟级稳定滚动。

papers.title: Screening Is Effective for Visual Recognition
papers.authors: Shunya Shimomura, Kazuhiro Hotta
papers.affiliations: Meijo University
papers.intro: 论文提出 VisionScreen，将语言模型中的 Screening 机制扩展至二维图像网格，通过基于查询-键相似度的绝对相关性估计与阈值化显式排除低相关图像块，实现选择性特征聚合，在图像分类任务上超越标准 ViT。

papers.title: Peak-End-Net: A Peak-End Rule Inspired Framework for Generalizable Video Aesthetic Assessment
papers.authors: Geng Li, Haiwen Li, Rui Chen, Jing Tang, Lei Sun, Xiangxiang Chu
papers.affiliations: Alibaba Group (AMAP) 和 Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
papers.intro: 本文提出Peak-End-Net，一个受心理学“峰值-末端规则”启发的轻量级、可解释视频美学评估框架，通过图像美学先验、峰值-末端聚合、美学节奏编码和动态门控融合实现跨数据集的良好泛化。

papers.title: SIVA-RL: Sensitivity-Invariance Visual Alignment for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Cheng Tang, Junzhi Ning, Min Cen, Wei Li, Xinyi Zeng, Pinxian Zeng, Rongbin Li, Qiming Zhu, Yuqiang Li, Junjun He, Yirong Chen, Ming Hu
papers.affiliations: Cheng Tang - Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory Junzhi Ning - Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory Min Cen - Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory Wei Li - Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Shanghai Jiao Tong University Xinyi Zeng - Shanghai Artificial Intelligence L
papers.intro: SIVA-RL提出一种基于样本级结果条件路由的视觉对齐框架，用局部PatchSwap干预和冻结审计策略的奖励变化，将分类为敏感性和不变性对齐，替代固定干预类型监督。
